about: The cidr datatype: an IPv4 or IPv6 address and its prefix length, as a WireGuard interface's addresses and a peer's allowed IPs are written. The address may carry host bits (10.0.0.1/24 is an interface address). The shell (datatype.go) and a list's add (verso-forms.js) are both held to these cases.

refuse.why: a bare address has no prefix length
a bare address has no prefix length
a length is written without leading zeros
a netmask is not a prefix length
an IPv4 part is written without leading zeros
a name is not an address
